hook.text: Fuse two organoids together — assembloids model how different brain regions connect and communicate.

buildup.text: Dorsal and ventral forebrain organoids fuse to show interneuron migration — neurons travel between regions as in development.

discovery.text: Cortico-striatal assembloids model the circuit disrupted in autism — patient-derived assembloids show abnormal neuron migration.

twist.text: As assembloids grow more complex, ethical concerns escalate — multi-region brain structures raise questions about sentience.

climax.text: Gut-brain assembloids model the enteric nervous system — studying how the gut communicates with the brain through neural circuits.

punchline.text: Connect mini-organs — assembloids reveal how tissues talk in development and disease.

quiz.question: What do cortico-striatal assembloids reveal about autism?
options: That autism is caused by gut bacteria
Patient-derived assembloids show abnormal neuron migration between brain regions that may underlie the disorder
That all brain organoids from autistic patients fail to grow
